lore.modestmagic.altar: The heart of all magic. Surround it with Pedestals and place an item on each, then sneak-use the Altar or power it with Flux to infuse items, enchant gear, or summon creatures.
lore.modestmagic.pedestal: A stand that holds an ingredient for an Altar ritual. Place them around an Altar.
lore.modestmagic.stardust: Glittering dust ground from a Nether Star. A magical ingredient for Altar rituals.
lore.modestmagic.enchantment_tablet: A blank stone tablet forged from Rose Gold and Amethyst. Infuse it at an Altar to inscribe it with enchantments.
lore.modestmagic.enchantment_tablet_aqua: An Enchantment Tablet that grants Respiration, Capacity, or Depth Strider. On a Collar Tag it grants Amphibious. Each use at an Anvil adds one level of every enchantment the gear can take, up to that enchantment's maximum.
lore.modestmagic.enchantment_tablet_cycl: An Enchantment Tablet that grants Sweeping Edge, Riptide, or Vengeance. Each use at an Anvil adds one level of every enchantment the gear can take, up to that enchantment's maximum.

lore.modestmagic.enchantment_tablet_flin: An Enchantment Tablet that grants Launch, Multishot, or Volley. On a Collar Tag it grants Deflecting. Each use at an Anvil adds one level of every enchantment the gear can take, up to that enchantment's maximum.
lore.modestmagic.enchantment_tablet_glac: An Enchantment Tablet that grants Frost Walker. On a Collar Tag it grants Frost Fang. Each use at an Anvil adds one level of every enchantment the gear can take, up to that enchantment's maximum.
